Brighton reached the Conference League after brushing Tromso aside in the play-offs with a 4-0 aggregate victory and enter the competition as one of the favourites.

Fabian Hurzeler’s side have made an excellent start to the Premier League season, sitting third with 18 goals scored in six matches, and will hope to replicate their domestic form in this European encounter against Lithuanian minnows Kauno Zalgiris.

English clubs have won the Conference League in three of the five seasons since the competition’s creation, with Brighton’s bitter rivals Crystal Palace previously lifting the trophy in May.

Hurzeler has made eight changes to the team which beat Sunderland last Saturday, with Jack Hinshelwood notably returning to the line-up.

Whatever the result, this is a momentous night for Bournemouth, who are poised for their first European fixture at home in the club’s history as they welcome Austrian outfit Sturm Graz to the Vitality Stadium.

Bournemouth kickstarted their inaugural Europa League campaign with an unforgettable 2-1 victory over Real Sociedad on September 17 in San Sebastian, thanks to first-half goals from Justin Kluivert and Rayan.

Industry observers note that this was just Bournemouth’s second win of the season in all competitions, with the club having made a slow start to the campaign under new head coach Marco Rose. That other triumph arrived in the EFL Cup, when Bournemouth thrashed Lincoln City 4-0 at the start of September.

The buzz around Bournemouth’s European exploits have partially masked a very poor opening to the Premier League season as Rose’s winless side languish in 18th, with only three points from six games. They suffered a heavy 5-1 loss to Chelsea at Stamford Bridge in their previous outing.

It has been revealed that palace manager Pierre Sage managed Lyon between November 2023 and January 2025, and another sub-plot is American businessman John Textor’s involvement with the French club. The former Palace shareholder was the reason the club missed out on Europa League participation last season because Lyon were in the same competition and thus Palace were considered in breach of multi-club ownership rules. Textor sold his stake in Palace, but despite the club’s best efforts they had to settle for the Conference League, a competition they subsequently won.

Recent findings suggest that palace could have been three or four down against Nottingham Forest at the weekend but fought back for a much-needed Premier League victory. They made a winning start in Europe, beating Lech Poznan 4-0 at Selhurst Park in their opening Europa League game.

Sources indicate that bournemouth and Sunderland also made winning starts, despite both teams’ poor form domestically. Sunderland travel to Portuguese side Torreense, while Sturm Graz are the opposition for Bournemouth’s first ever European game at the Vitality Stadium (or Dean Court if you prefer). Bournemouth continue to be without Justin Kluivert, Eli Junior Kroupi and Alex Scott because of injury.

In a recent development, brighton are favourites to win the Conference League and play their first game in the competition against Lithuanian club Kauno Zalgiris. Lifting the trophy in Istanbul at the end of the season would assure Brighton of a place in next season’s Europa League, though given their Premier League form and Manchester City’s predicament, Champions League qualification could be a realistic aspiration. Brighton won with 10 men at Sunderland on Saturday, and were successful in their appeal against Pascal Struijk’s red card.

Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news. Click here for a free trial!

Sky add that the Portuguese playmaker has rejected two contract offers from United. The Red Devils’ initial proposal was made in the summer when discussions first began, but it was turned down. United do have a one-year option that they can trigger.

It has been revealed that “No, there’s no negotiations ongoing, but I’ve seen people saying that ‘he’s asked for more money, he’s asked for more years’. If I wanted more money, I wouldn’t be here. I had somewhere to go to get much more money than being at Manchester United,” he noted.

According to recent reports, “I could have been in a place that is much warmer than Manchester! Two summers ago, three summers ago, last summer, I always had the chance to leave and I always chose to be here.

It has been revealed that “The thing is, I’ve always indicated how much I care about the club and how much I want to win at this club. And I always stated, in the moment the club thinks it’s time for me to move on, I will move on.

Sources indicate that “I’m not going to be the player that I’ve seen many in this time at Manchester United. They’re going to stay here just by staying, just finish my contract and then we will see. In the moment the club states, ‘Bruno, it’s time to part ways’, I’m going to be the first one walking out the door.

“Yes, the club offered me a fresh contract, so I think that, from their side, indicates that they want me to stay. And as you stated, there are no negotiations going on.

“We spoke about the contract at the end of last season, we came in the beginning of this season speaking about the contract, but about the context of the team and the club, I just put that to a side because I don’t think it’s the right moment, neither for me, nor for the club, to be talking about negotiations because the most notable thing now is that the club gets back to win games.

“My aim will always be to win the Premier League and the Champions League within the club I am. I will never hide from that, I will never say, no, our position at the moment needs to be to get top four.”.

Industry observers note that recently, Fernandes’ name has been mentioned in conjunction with Milan, who are looking to boost the level of their squad with quality signings. The former Sporting CP man knows head coach Ruben Amorim well, and could help fill the void if Luka Modric retires/departs.

Fabrizio Romano even spoke of the idea being ‘more than a dream’ for the Rossoneri management, while The Athletic also reported that the 32-year-old is an option Milan are exploring after he turned down United’s second offer.

Since joining Manchester United in January 2020, Bruno Fernandes has recorded 113 goals and 111 assists in 340 appearances across all competitions.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Gary Neville remarked he expects Arsenal to ‘canter’ to the Premier League title after Liverpool’s emphatic win over ten-man Manchester United.

Defending champions Arsenal are six points clear at the top of the table despite failing to extend their winning run against Newcastle United in a 2-2 draw.

The blow of failing to win at St James’ Park was substantially softened by the fact virtually all of the teams chasing Arsenal also dropped points.

Second-placed Brighton suffered a shock 2-0 defeat at newly-promoted Hull City while Manchester City’s surprising slump continued as Enzo Maresca’s side could only draw 1-1 at home to Fulham.

The only team in the top-four to win this weekend was Liverpool, who smashed ten-man Manchester United 4-0, but the Reds are still a healthy seven points adrift of Arsenal.

Mikel Arteta ended Arsenal’s 22-year wait for a Premier League trophy last season and eight-time title winner Neville expects the Gunners to retain that crown in a ‘very strange’ domestic campaign.

‘Looking at the Premier League top-six right now, Arsenal are clearly the standout team and are going to win the league at a canter,’ Neville remarked on his Sky Sports podcast.

‘But the rest of the usual top five or six teams, it’s not been this bad has it for a long time? They’re really struggling.

Industry observers note that ‘Liverpool were obviously a bit better today but Chelsea are struggling, Tottenham are struggling. Manchester United are struggling, Manchester City look like they’ve fallen off a cliff right now compared to the standards they set under Pep Guardiola.

According to recent reports, ‘So it’s a really interesting time where other teams are starting to emerge and it’s becoming a lot more competitive. It’s a very strange league this year.’.

Jamie Carragher also expects the Premier League trophy to be staying in north London despite being encouraged by Liverpool’s win over struggling Manchester United.

‘I still think there’s just an inconsistency with Liverpool game-to-game at the moment,’ the Anfield legend remarked. ‘I think they will get better the longer the season goes on and people want there to be a title race.

‘But I think most people in the country would look at Arsenal as a team and say they will probably win the title comfortably.

Are Manchester United in a relegation fight? 🤔 pic.twitter.com/jicPbrP2EU.

‘For me, with Liverpool being my team, I want them to be in a position to be the strongest challenger this season and put themselves in a position that they can then challenge Arsenal next season.’.

While Liverpool climbed back into the top-four by beating Manchester United, the Red Devils sunk to 19th in the Premier League.

United were thrashed in Mauricio Pochettino’s first game in charge after Leny Yoro was sent off inside ten minutes at Anfield.

Despite Manchester United’s dismal position, Neville refused to say his former club were in a relegation battle.

It has been revealed that ‘I don’t believe they are in a relegation fight,’ Neville added. ‘They are second bottom but I do think they will come out of it and start to move up the table.

In a recent development, ‘It’s embarrassing really. It’s really desperate and it’s tiring watching them. This is the worst Manchester United have ever been in 53 years.’.

  • Manchester United striker Joshua Zirkzee could reportedly become the first player to leave Old Trafford during the January transfer window.
  • The Dutchman joined the Red Devils from Bologna in the summer of 2024 and has since made 86 appearances for the club across all competitions.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Saikat Mandal | 23 Nov 2026 12:44.

Manchester United striker Joshua Zirkzee could reportedly become the first player to leave Old Trafford during the January transfer window.

The Dutchman joined the Red Devils from Bologna in the summer of 2024 and has since made 86 appearances for the club across all competitions.

Zirkzee has managed just 11 goals and four assists for Man Utd and was heavily linked with a move away from the club during the summer transfer window.

Several Serie A clubs were keen to sign him, with Fiorentina reportedly agreeing a loan fee for the striker, but the proposed move ultimately failed to materialise.

Premier League rivals Everton also made a late push for the 25-year-old, but Man Utd were unwilling to let him leave without first securing a replacement.

Former Man Utd manager Michael Carrick even suggested that Zirkzee could become an notable player for the club, but the striker has since slipped considerably down the pecking order.

According to La Gazzetta dello Sport (via Manchester Evening News), Zirkzee is expected to become the first player to depart in January, with several Italian clubs competing for his signature.

Juventus and Fiorentina are reportedly keen to sign the striker, while Napoli could also enter the race.

The former Bayern Munich attacker has made just seven substitute appearances in the Premier League this season, accumulating 134 minutes of action and scoring once.

Zirkzee has also featured three times as a substitute in the Champions League, where he has registered another goal.

Mauricio Pochettino introduced him in the second half of Man Utd's 4-0 defeat against Liverpool, and the Dutchman managed to make a positive impression despite the disappointing result.

Towards the end of the contest, Zirkzee produced a brilliant pass to Bruno Fernandes, but the United captain's effort was comfortably saved by Alisson Becker.

If Zirkzee fails to earn more opportunities under Pochettino over the coming month, the likelihood of him leaving Old Trafford could increase considerably.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Peter Schmeichel believes simply avoiding relegation should be Mauricio Pochettino’s main ‘target’ at Manchester United this season.
  • Pochettino took charge of United for the first time away to bitter rivals Liverpool on Sunday afternoon and it proved a nightmare start for the Argentine, with his side thumped 4-0 at Anfield.
  • The Red Devils were reduced to ten men in only the tenth minute after Leny Yoro brought down Alexander Isak, and the visitors’ woes were compounded as Dominik Szoboszlai scored with the resulting free-kick.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Peter Schmeichel believes simply avoiding relegation should be Mauricio Pochettino’s main ‘target’ at Manchester United this season.

Pochettino took charge of United for the first time away to bitter rivals Liverpool on Sunday afternoon and it proved a nightmare start for the Argentine, with his side thumped 4-0 at Anfield.

The Red Devils were reduced to ten men in only the tenth minute after Leny Yoro brought down Alexander Isak, and the visitors’ woes were compounded as Dominik Szoboszlai scored with the resulting free-kick.

Man-of-the-match Florian Wirtz doubled Liverpool’s advantage with an audacious finish just three minutes later, before a pair of second-half goals from Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz put the hosts out of sight.

The result ensured United remained firmly in the relegation zone at the end of the weekend’s drama, only one point better off than rock-bottom Crystal Palace.

The Old Trafford giants, who now lead Europe’s top five leagues for most goals conceded (34 in all competitions), will look to stop the rot when they switch their focus to Champions League matters at Sporting on Wednesday evening.

Three days later, Pochettino’s men return to Premier League action at home to Brentford.

‘Realistically, can Manchester United just finish tenth or 12th? It would be okay,’ former United goalkeeper Schmeichel stated on Viaplay following the side’s heavy defeat on Merseyside.

‘I know it’s silly to say but we are in the relegation zone and this team looks like a team that could get relegated.

Use AI to go deeper into the stories you care about – powered by Metro and trusted publications.

In a recent development, ‘So now that should be the target. Weirdly enough, at the moment it looks like it [that avoiding relegation is the target].

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

‘But we [Viaplay’s punditry panel] have all played in the Premier League so we know we’re in November, we’re approaching December, it’s not really now.

‘It’s when we get to March and if they keep doing this for so long, I mean there’s going to be trouble.

‘But I think, at least I have faith that he [Pochettino] can correct those things.

‘He’s never going to make them a championship winning team, not these guys.’.

To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video.

It was some calamitous defending from Matthijs de Ligt and Leny Yoro that led to Liverpool’s breakthrough against United, with the latter guilty of fouling Alexander Isak after failing to cover his centre-back partner.

And while it was De Ligt that made the initial mistake, Yoro was the main focus of Schmeichel’s post-match criticism.

‘I think Isak is doing really well,’ the Dane noted when watching back replays of the move.

‘When Yoro comes in, Isak cuts across him and yes, he brings him down.

In a recent development, ‘It’s terrible defending, it is. Not for that on its own but why is he not reading the ball over the top, over De Ligt?

‘Yoro should have been supporting his co-defender and he’s not.’.

Schmeichel has long been an outspoken critic of Lisandro Martinez and branded the defender ‘disgraceful’ in the wake of United’s 2-0 loss to Chelsea last month.

It came just a fortnight after Martinez had launched an explosive attack on United’s board, in which he suggested the squad had been repeatedly let down by the club’s recruitment team.

In a recent development, ‘I’m fed up talking about him. Honestly, I’m fed up talking about him,’ Schmeichel noted of Martinez following United’s latest setback.

‘He’s a guy that criticises people upstairs, criticises his team-mates… I think you have to perform better than that, I really do think that.

‘You can through not all of the goals, but you can go through a couple of the goals and he’s there, at the centre of that, and he could have done something to at least make it harder for Liverpool to score.’.

  • Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Youssouf Fofana continues to impress with Sevilla, and AC Milan are already thinking about what to do ahead of next summer.

Recent findings suggest that as Calciomercato.com write, Fofana put in a solid performance in Saturday’s Seville derby at the Estadio Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán, which finished 1-1. He was positioned alongside Lucien Agoume in the double pivot at first, but as the game went on he took up more of a box-to-box role.

Read SempreMilan ad-free and get access to exclusive news. Click here for a free trial!

The home side’s first chance came from him, around the sixth minute, following a long-range free kick that went just over the top of the net defended by Alvaro Valles. He was a constant presence in the Betis penalty area, operating even behind the striker at times.

It has been revealed that after Antony’s opening goal, Fofana continued to push forward in the second half, coming close to equalising in the 82nd minute. Sevilla did draw level in the 91st minute thanks to a powerful left-footed strike from Kike Salas that Valles failed to hold.

Recent findings suggest that fofana experienced a frantic end to the summer window after Ruben Amorim opted to exclude him from Milan’s aims. A move to Lyon collapsed on deadline day, allowing Sevilla to swoop and land him on a dry loan for the season.

Industry observers note that the Frenchman has racked up 10 appearances in total in LaLiga, nine of them as a starter. He has been described as a ‘gift’ by his head coach, having scored a goal against Barcelona and having amassed three assists, provided against Levante and Osasuna.

According to recent reports, what does the future hold beyond 2026-27? In July, barring any surprises, he will return to Milan to discuss the next steps. Having contract expiring in 2028 remains a factor in the background, and renewal at the moment appears unlikely with Juventus, Spurs and Manchester United all linked in recent weeks.

#83626. Real Madrid: Mourinho faces attacking dilemma ahead of Champions League clash with PSV

📖 Baca
General ⚠️ Warning 🌐 Co ↗ Open Full Page

Real Madrid: Mourinho faces attacking dilemma ahead of Champions League clash with PSV

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1112 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Axel Clody | 23 Nov 2026 13:19.
  • Real Madrid go into Tuesday's Champions League clash with PSV on the back of nine consecutive victories, but with crucial issues for Jose Mourinho to manage.
  • Sources indicate that vinicius Junior came off the bench to take a direct part in both goals, with the assist for Carlos Espi deciding the match.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Axel Clody | 23 Nov 2026 13:19.

Real Madrid go into Tuesday's Champions League clash with PSV on the back of nine consecutive victories, but with crucial issues for Jose Mourinho to manage. Saturday's 2-1 comeback win over Celta Vigo was another example of the team's ability to react, but it also exposed problems that the manager cannot ignore.

Sources indicate that vinicius Junior came off the bench to take a direct part in both goals, with the assist for Carlos Espi deciding the match. The Brazilian, who had served a four-match suspension in La Liga, has regained prominence and has already had his place in the starting line-up for the European tie confirmed by Mourinho. At the same time, the Spanish centre-forward again demonstrated that he can be decisive even with few minutes on the pitch.

Sources indicate that the challenge is to find room for so many options without compromising the collective structure. Real Madrid have Kylian Mbappe, Vinicius, Jude Bellingham, Arda Guler, Yan Diomande and Espi, as well as names who could come into the mix, such as Endrick and Bernardo Silva, but they cannot simply put them all on the pitch and hope that individual talent solves everything.

Sources indicate that vinicius's display against Celta was a reminder of what the Brazilian offers Real Madrid. Coming on 12 minutes into the second half, he gave the attack depth and was able to unbalance defenders in one-on-one situations. For the equaliser, he started the move that ended with Bellingham. For the winner, he crossed for Espi to pounce on the rebound.

Mourinho confirmed that the Brazilian will start against PSV, ending the debate about his status in the team. Peter Bosz's side are known for high pressing, aggressive defending and their attempts to win the ball back rapidly. When that first press is beaten, however, they tend to offer space behind the defenders.

Recent findings suggest that that is precisely where Vinicius can be decisive. With his acceleration and ability to attack the space in behind, the Brazilian is a constant threat to a defence that often plays a high line and takes on individual duels all over the pitch. Mbappe can also exploit these spaces.

Sources indicate that the question for Mourinho is how to make this threat work without leaving the midfield exposed. Real Madrid cannot rely solely on winning the ball back and launching it to the forwards. They need players close by to connect transitions and sustain possession when necessary.

The presence of Bellingham and Guler between the lines could be vital. The Englishman offers ball-carrying and arrivals into the box, while the Turkey international has the quality to find passes that speed up the attack. But the team needs a solid base behind them. Without that, the freedom of the attacking players could prove costly.

It has been revealed that espi's situation is another dilemma. The 21-year-old forward scored the winner against Celta and has three goals in only 44 minutes played in La Liga this season. It is impressive efficiency, but it does not necessarily mean that he should start.

Mourinho was clear in explaining the Spaniard's characteristics. Espi is a penalty-box centre-forward, strong in the air, able to play with his back to goal and to attack the spaces close to the six-yard box. He is not, however, a forward with great mobility to take part constantly in build-up play. The manager also said that the squad does not have the right characteristics to play a pure 4-4-2 with Mbappe and Espi together.

It has been revealed that mbappe likes to start from the left or occupy the space between the full-back and the centre-back, but he is not a traditional winger who tracks the opposition full-back back into his own half. Vinicius also needs freedom to receive the ball wide and accelerate. Putting Espi alongside the Frenchman would require the two wide players to tuck in more and help form a four-man midfield line.

There are alternatives, but all involve compromises. Bellingham could play deeper, for example. The problem is that Real Madrid would lose part of the Englishman's ability to arrive in the box and would need a midfielder with greater defensive responsibility to compensate. It would also be possible to use Espi in matches where the opposition sit deep and offer less space for the runs of Vinicius and Mbappe.

According to recent reports, against tired defences and crosses, Espi offers something different from the other forwards in the squad. His efficiency as a substitute should not be confused with an obligation to change the whole structure of the team.

Industry observers note that the win over Celta also left a warning. After turning the scoreline around, Real Madrid finished the game with four forwards on the pitch, as well as Bellingham and Guler in midfield. Mourinho admitted that the team became unbalanced and that he would have liked an extra substitution to bring on Tchouameni and restore defensive protection.

Recent findings suggest that under Bosz, PSV rely on high pressing, dominating possession, constant movement and a defence that often takes on individual duels. The full-backs can advance into midfield and the forwards take part in the press. It is an aggressive model, capable of suffocating opponents, but one that also leaves space when the first line is beaten.

The impact of each at Real Madrid in 2026-27.

In a recent development, direct involvements = goals + assists. In the Champions League, Vinicius played four games without a goal or an assist; Espi scored one goal in four games, against Roma. Points gained assume that, without Espi's goals, the three games would have ended in draws. Data up to 21 November 2026.

Sources: FotMob (Opta data), AS and TheStatsAPI.

Real Madrid have the tools to exploit these gaps. Vinicius and Mbappe can attack the space in behind, while Bellingham and Guler have the ability to receive between the lines and speed up the transition. The difficulty will be doing so without turning the game into a series of attacks and counter-attacks.

Real Madrid won their first four league-phase games in the Champions League and are second, with 12 points. The positive run brings calm, but it does not remove the need to improve the collective performance.

It has been revealed that mourinho already has an answer to one of the questions: Vinicius will start. He also knows what Espi can offer and why he does not intend simply to put him alongside Mbappe. The bigger challenge is to make Real Madrid take advantage of the quality of their attackers without losing control of midfield.

Milan went into the international break inside the top four, but Como’s win on Saturday has pushed them back out, so there is some added pressure tonight. It will not be an easy game against a newly-promoted Frosinone side who have started the season very well and are full of confidence.

Industry observers note that it looks like Luka Modric will be flanked by Adrien Rabiot and Yunus Musah in a midfield three, though the Frenchman could play a bit further forward. Diego Moreira and Christian Pulisic are the wingers either side of Goncalo Ramos.

We have become accustomed to line-ups appearing a certain way and being used differently under Amorim though, so there may be some surprises compared to how the team looks on paper.

Sabah vs Barcelona - prediction, team news, lineups

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (739 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Matt Law | 23 Nov 2026 13:30, Last updated: 24 Nov 2026 13:43.
  • Barcelona will aim to make it five straight wins in all competitions when they continue their Champions League campaign away to Sabah on Wednesday night.
  • History will be made in this contest, as the two teams prepare to lock horns for the first time, and it would be one of the biggest shocks in Champions League history should Sabah manage to overcome the La Liga champions.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Matt Law | 23 Nov 2026 13:30, Last updated: 24 Nov 2026 13:43.

Barcelona will aim to make it five straight wins in all competitions when they continue their Champions League campaign away to Sabah on Wednesday night.

History will be made in this contest, as the two teams prepare to lock horns for the first time, and it would be one of the biggest shocks in Champions League history should Sabah manage to overcome the La Liga champions.

Sabah boast a record of one win and three draws from their four matches in this season's Champions League league phase, which has left them in 31st spot in the table on three points, one point behind 24th-placed PSV Eindhoven.

The Owls opened their league stage campaign with a 4-0 loss to Manchester United, before managing to record a 2-0 victory over Slavia Prague in their second fixture to put three points on the board, but they have since lost to Borussia Dortmund and Viking FC.

Valdas Dambrauskas's side will enter this match off the back of a huge domestic win, beating Sumqayit 5-1, with the result leaving them third in Azerbaijan's top flight, picking up 24 points from their opening 11 games of the season.

Including qualification matches, Sabah have a record of seven wins and five losses in this season's Champions League, keeping five clean sheets in the process.

The Owls had never played in the European Cup before this season, so it is a historic campaign for the club, and they will take on Villarreal, Napoli and Arsenal in their three Champions League league stage fixtures after this one.

As for Barcelona, the Catalan side are right now fifth in the league phase table, picking up nine points from their four matches courtesy of a record of three wins and one defeat.

Hansi Flick's side beat Feyenoord and Galatasaray in their opening two league stage fixtures before suffering a 4-2 reverse to Paris Saint-Germain, but they managed to post a 3-0 victory over Aston Villa last time out to get back on track.

Barcelona will enter this match off the back of a 3-2 win over Villarreal, with that result moving them back to the top of the La Liga table, three points ahead of Real Madrid.

The Catalan side lost in the last-16 stage of last season's Champions League to Atletico Madrid, and it remains to be seen whether their defensive unit is strong enough to make a serious challenge for the 2026-27 European Cup.

Barcelona have actually conceded in each of their last 12 away group stage/league phase matches, but they have scored at least twice in 17 of their last 19 games at this point.

Barcelona Champions League form:.

Barcelona form (all competitions):.

Sabah will be without the services of Aden McCarthy, with the centre-back suspended on Wednesday following his red card in the team's last Champions League match with Viking.

The hosts also need to make a check on the fitness of Veljko Simic, who is struggling with an injury; the attacker has eight goals in 18 appearances this season and his absence would therefore be a major blow for Sabah.

Joy-Lance Mickels has been in impressive form this season, scoring 12 goals in 22 appearances, and the forward is set to start for the home team.

As for Barcelona, Lamine Yamal will not be involved due to a slight ankle problem, with Barcelona not prepared to take any risks when it comes to the Spain international.

Roony Bardghji (knee), Xavi Espart (ankle), Rodri (hamstring) and Andreas Christensen (muscle) are also unavailable for selection.

Pau Cubarsi did not play against Villarreal on Sunday due to an issue that he sustained while on international duty with Spain, but the centre-back was on the bench and should feature in the starting team.

Meanwhile, Anthony Gordon and Karim Adeyemi are expected to join Raphinha in the final third of the field due to the absence of Yamal.

Sabah possible starting lineup:.

Pokatilov; Zedadka, Solvet, Almeida, Puchaz; Lepinjica, Isayev, Rakhomaliev; Severina, Mbina, Mickels.

Barcelona possible starting lineup:.

J Garcia; E Garcia, Cubarsi, Martin, Cancelo; Fermin, Bernal, Pedri; Adeyemi, Raphinha, Gordon.

Yamal's absence is a major blow for Barcelona, but the Catalan outfit have enough quality in their side to secure all three points on Wednesday.

Mauricio Pochettino explains his shock team selection in nightmare first Man Utd match

📅 23 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (580 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Mauricio Pochettino may have left Gary Neville ‘absolutely stunned’ by picking Matthijs de Ligt against Liverpool, but the Manchester United manager notes there was a simple reason for it.
  • The newly introduced Red Devils boss had a tough opening game in charge as he took his side to Anfield and it ended up being a nightmare debut for the Argentine.
  • Leny Yoro was shown a red card after eight minutes and Dominik Szoboszlai scored from the resulting free-kick.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Mauricio Pochettino may have left Gary Neville ‘absolutely stunned’ by picking Matthijs de Ligt against Liverpool, but the Manchester United manager notes there was a simple reason for it.

The newly introduced Red Devils boss had a tough opening game in charge as he took his side to Anfield and it ended up being a nightmare debut for the Argentine.

Leny Yoro was shown a red card after eight minutes and Dominik Szoboszlai scored from the resulting free-kick.

Florian Wirtz, Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz also netted to complete a comfortable 4-0 win for Andoni Iraola’s men.

Manchester United have now picked up just eight points from 11 games and sit 19th in the Premier League table. Every other club in the division has more wins than the one they have managed.

While the Red Devils clearly have many problems, De Ligt has been a focus of criticism after his performance at Anfield.

The Dutch defender has recovered from a long-term injury, but was starting in the Premier League for the first time in nearly a year, having made two Champions League appearances this season.

The 27-year-old looked a long way off Premier League pace as he was run ragged by the Liverpool front line.

Asked why he went for De Ligt alongside Yoro over Harry Maguire, who started on the bench but has been playing regularly this season, Pochettino said: ‘He was training, he played in Champions League before the international duty. I think, when we arrived we saw the combination.’.

Use AI to go deeper into the stories you care about – powered by Metro and trusted publications.

He then swiftly turned his attention to claiming Liverpool defender Jeremy Jacquet could have given away a penalty for a challenge on Bryan Mbeumo before Yoro was dismissed.

According to recent reports, ‘I repeat again, if Jacquet was penalty and the referee say that it’s a penalty, for sure that action after never comes and maybe we’re talking another way,’ he said. ‘But one centre-back made a mistake, wasn’t punished. Us, we made one mistake and we were punished.

‘And now I accept all the situation, but the circumstances were the circumstances and it’s so vital to put the circumstances in front, always.’.

Gary Neville watched De Ligt play in the defeat to Como in October and was surprised that he was given the nod at Anfield after his performance in Italy.

‘When I saw Matthijs de Ligt’s name on the teamsheet, I have to be honest with you, I was absolutely stunned,’ Neville said on Sky Sports.

‘The reason I was stunned was because of this: if you watched him against Como four weeks ago, he was very much well off it.’.

According to recent reports, neville added: ‘We saw it against Como and he’s been out for a year, trying to come back to this level of football. It’s really tough.

‘To have De Ligt out there in a game like this, in a back four, he’s been exposed inside the first ten minutes.’.
